The '''Main Vault''' of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] was located in the [[Unidentified Scipio city|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]. Located within an immense tower which dominated the city's skyline, the Main Vault housed all of the Banking Clan's records and provided them access to their clients' accounts.
